# Exit-Ticket Cadence - Quick Brief

**Date**: 2026-11-19

## Summary
Daily two-question exit tickets lift retention of covered material across classrooms [1]. Completion stays under three minutes whenever each ticket holds two questions [2]. Weekly checks suit content that changes little between lessons [3]. The retention data favours the daily cadence with a strict question cap [1].

## Key Points
- **Point 1**: Daily two-question tickets lift retention of covered material by a clear margin [1].
- **Point 2**: Completion stays under three minutes when each ticket holds two questions [2].
- **Point 3**: Weekly checks suit content that changes little between lessons [3].

## Action Items
1. Adopt daily exit tickets with a cap of two questions.
2. Review the weekly aggregate every Friday during planning period.
3. Revisit the decision at half term with the retention data.

## Bibliography
[1] Alpha Analytics (2024). "Retention pace in classroom practice". https://example.com/alpha
